exploration-launch.png:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-page landscape cinematic worldbuilding illustration, 1536 by 1024 pixels, no text.
Primary request: Make the reader physically feel standing with a freely associated near-future exploration community as their shared civilian robotic mission lifts off at dawn. A plausible, beautiful future they can aspire to inhabit, no luxury advertising.
Scene: Eye-height from a public planted hill terrace beside a shared observatory and timber-and-metal homes. In the close foreground, a child's hand rests on a stone railing beside an elder's hand; a small diverse group of friends and neighbors in ordinary comfortable clothes look outward, expressive side profiles visible. A person quietly holds a small mission tablet, its screen only abstract luminous shapes. A seated wheelchair user watches alongside everyone. Reusable mugs on the railing, a folded blanket, dew on leaves: a real morning. Midground paths, community workshop windows and observatory dome show this is their home.
Across a VERY broad body of water several kilometers away, a slender civilian rocket ascends from an isolated coastal launch range. Distant small bright flame and tall dawn-lit vapor plume, no weapon imagery. The inhabited terrace and rocket are clearly far apart, separated by water and extensive empty range. The launch is an emotional shared endeavor, not a VIP spectacle.
Style: high-end cinematic architectural concept painting with convincing natural material detail and human scale; warm dawn, cool water, restrained near-future technology. The rocket is an elegant focal point in the distant sky but faces, hands, landscape and communal belonging carry the image.
Composition: wide 3:2 image with clear foreground-middle-distance depth, physically believable perspective, people large enough to feel present, no flat distant crowd.
Constraints: no letters, readable text, captions, logos, watermark, interface bars, weapon, military vehicles, billionaire yacht, fireworks, giant holographic ads or launch pad within the town. No fantastical interstellar spacecraft.
exploration-section.png:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: landscape architectural story section for an illustrated future worldbook, 1536 by 1024 pixels.
Primary request: An impressive, inhabited architectural cutaway of a near-future community mission campus, showing how a shared passion for exploring space becomes a real environment where one can live, learn and make instruments together.
Scene and composition: One coherent multi-level building shown as a three-quarter perspective section with the near facade cleanly removed, spanning the whole wide image. At lower left a beautiful double-height public listening and data hall contains people reclining on benches and steps watching a large scientifically evocative image of an icy moon, with no text. Beside it, a glazed boundary reveals a tall, controlled clean instrument-assembly bay: modest robotic handling arms, a partially assembled robotic space probe and telescope payload on fixtures, technicians around an inspection bench, overhead maintenance gantry, clearly separate from public circulation. On the right a bright teaching and prototyping workshop with small optics assemblies and friendly mixed-age groups. Higher up, a roof observation garden and observatory dome connected by an occupied terrace. A low service level underneath carries component carts and returnable containers on a distinct route, storage racks and equipment rooms, physically plausible access stairs and lift core connecting floors. Visible timber panels and reusable steel structural bays, ducts and service routes, precisely crafted glass and metal.
Atmosphere: daylight pours through tall clerestories; warm inhabited commons, cooler controlled assembly space. Make the architecture large and aspirational yet legible, not a technical exploded diagram. Actual human activity in each room shows scale and purpose. A planted housing neighborhood and distant sky outside establish the campus as part of a city.
Style: superb architectural cutaway visualization, tactile near-photoreal materials, cinematic but clear, crisp visible spatial relationships, rich color. We need to SEE the engineering as architecture and the joyful collective scientific life together.
Constraints: No labels, readable text, numbers, captions, legend, watermark or logos. No rocket launch or fueled rocket inside this populated site. No military themes, no magic antigravity, no transparent ghost building overlay, no stacks of disconnected inset panels. A single coherent inhabitable building section.
quest-bridge.png:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: cinematic embodied landscape illustration for a future worldbook, 1536 by 1024 pixels.
Primary request: Show what it FEELS like to live inside a collectively authored persistent MMORPG world in a real city, with friends, material culture and optional shared augmented reality. A close eye-height first-person journey across a canal bridge, with wonderful depth and a tangible built environment.
Scene: In the foreground a single anatomically convincing hand holds a beautifully crafted small physical guild token of brass and carved wood; an unreadable folded illustrated map tucked beneath it. At arm's length two close friends wear expressive layered cloaks over ordinary comfortable clothes and subtle clear AR glasses. One points with delighted curiosity toward the canal, inviting you to join the next part of a shared quest. Their faces are visible in three-quarter view. Real stone bridge, textured parapet, continuous handrails and wet paving stones feel touchable; a discreet small spatial tracking anchor is integrated into a lamp fitting, no readable display.
Along the canal below, neighbors conduct ordinary life: a café window, someone carrying groceries, a person tending balcony herbs, a small guild boat with folded cloth banners, other companions heading toward a workshop. Buildings are lived-in fantasy-inspired architecture made from believable timber, masonry and reusable structural parts.
Above the water a huge graceful translucent creature composed of luminous constellations curls through the air, reflected as stylized light in the canal: shared AR rendered from the viewer's perspective, an invitation to a collaborative mystery. It should evoke awe while leaving the real bridge and water perfectly clear. Dusk lanterns and warm domestic windows, indigo evening sky. The setting is a home and unfolding story, not a theme park.
Style: cinematic architectural storytelling, painterly photoreal textures, generous color, intimate human expression, fantastical perceptual layer contrasting gently with physical materials. Wide 3:2 view.
Constraints: no text, logos, readable map labels, HUD, statistics, score, combat, weapons, rollercoaster, amusement-park gates, branded device, crowded tourist spectacle. Do not hide engineering under a generic fantasy matte painting.
